edges = np.arange(2.5, 6.75 + 0.25, 0.25)
df['bin_idx'] = pd.cut(df['체류시간 (s)'], bins=edges, right=False, labels=False)
counts = df.groupby(['촉매로트군', 'bin_idx']).size().reset_index(name='n')
df = df.merge(counts, on=['촉매로트군', 'bin_idx'])
df = df[df['n'] >= 10]
